payload.title: Announcement audit trail in the newsroom
payload.description:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("Audit trail").

Goal: every announcement can be traced: which Story and version, which account, the text, who or what drafted and approved it and when, the post id and link, the cost, every state change and any error.

Shape: the announcement row (catalog) plus text in S3; the Story drawer shows "Announced on X by @account, 13 Nov 09:01, view post" or the current state; Administration > Announcements has a list with filters by state, read by account and time from the row's key and the Caducus delivery log, never a table scan; a withdrawal because of retirement appears as a note in the public revision history when that feature is on (PPY-156614); posting does not.

Depends on: the channel framework story. Relates to PPY-156614.

```gherkin
Feature: Every announcement can be traced
  If anything goes wrong on X we must be able to say exactly what was posted, by
  whom, when, at what cost, and why.

  Scenario: The Story shows its announcement
    Given an Article announced on 13 November at 09:01
    When Sam opens its drawer
    Then it says "Announced on X by @mom_test, 13 Nov 09:01" with a link to the post

  Scenario: The list shows the whole record
    When Ryan opens the announcements list
    Then each row shows the Story, the account, the text, who drafted and who approved, the time, the post link, the cost and the state

  Scenario: Failures are kept with their reason
    Given an announcement X refused
    Then the list shows it as failed with X's message and every attempt's time

  Scenario: A retirement withdrawal appears in the revision history
    Given MoM shows revision histories
    When an announced Article is retired and its post deleted
    Then the revision history notes that the announcement was withdrawn
```

Open questions: none.
